text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so sex cannot plausibly explain why he was selected over you. Raising the panel’s all-male composition would undermine your credibility, as it does not support an allegation of sex discrimination. 

While an all-male panel may reflect a lack of institutional diversity, it is not evidence of bias between two male applicants. Instead, focus on objective criteria. Follow up professionally on your request for a written explanation. Once received, examine whether the appointment adhered to merit-based hiring standards, particularly given your substantial administrative credentials and five years as deputy principal compared to the appointee's profile.
